summary: List one kind of resource in one namespace, as JSON. Read-only.

name.describe: one object, or every object of the kind when absent

layer2.enforced_by: Kubernetes RBAC: the kubeconfig in the vault belongs to a ServiceAccount bound to a Role with verbs get and list only, on the kinds listed, in the namespaces policy names. The API server refuses the rest with the broker removed from the path.
layer2.check: kubectl --kubeconfig <vault file> auth can-i delete pods --namespace <ns>  ->  no; kubectl auth can-i get secrets  ->  no
